text_block_list.text:
One day, after finishing some errands and returning
to the academy late at night—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Fufu~n☆ Marvelous, marvelous★

Where on earth is she going at this hour?
Dressed in gorgeous attire, heading out into town,
I worriedly followed after her—

By the time I reached the town,
I had lost sight of Marvelous Sunday.

The reason being the groups in costume
scattered here and there.
Feels a bit early for Halloween, though...

text_block_list.name: Cloaked Man
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, a red cloak or a blue cloak,
which one do you want?"

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Gimme, gimme☆
Gimme ALL the marvelous capes★

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Ah, they left.
I hope we can meet again.
choice_data_list: Ah, who in the world are those people...

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
"Everyone, this is a very rare Marvelous! ☆
It hardly ever shows up normally, but..."

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Maybe because Halloween's coming up?
Looks like they're holding the Night Parade of One Hundred Demons today☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
"So I decided to join in too,
and put on a marvelous outfit!☆"

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
I thought it'd show them
that we're fellow Marvelous buddies!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Well then, let's make tonight marvelous together☆

text_block_list.name: Masked Woman
text_block_list.text: Hey, am I pretty...?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, raven-black hair, gentle eyes,
and that mask and coat combo is just
too wonderful☆

text_block_list.name: Masked Woman
text_block_list.text: Really... Even with this?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Wah☆ What a surprise...
You're amazing! I didn't know you could convey marvelousness
like this. My heart's totally pounding★

text_block_list.name: Masked Woman
text_block_list.text:
E-Eeeh... That reaction was unexpected...
But, thank you.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
choice_data_list: What's wrong? Did you find something?
What's wrong? Did you find something?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Wiggle, wiggle... Ahaha☆
Wiggle wiggle wiggle... Huh!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Just watching makes me all squiggly inside.
Enchanting Marvelous☆ Ahahaha★

After that, the two of us went around talking
to various attendees, spending a fun yet peculiar time together, but—

Before I knew it, Marvelous Sunday
had suddenly vanished into thin air.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
—Ahahaha☆ It's the Night Parade of One Hundred Demons★
Hey, hey, where are you going?
Can I tag along too?

—There she is. Oblivious to my concern,
she's laughing happily.

Looking over, she was about to follow a strangely costumed group,
including a tengu, an astonishingly tall woman, and a slender, tall man.

Goosebumps ran across my entire body.
I must not get involved with that group.
For some reason, I couldn't shake that feeling.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Po☆ Po-po-po★ Po-ppo-po~☆
Just as I thought, it's a heart-fluttering marvelousness★

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Hey, why don't you tell me more about yourselves?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
I'll make sure everyone hears all about
your marvelousness! ☆
choice_data_list: At this rate, she'll... In that case!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Huh, Trainer?
choice_data_list: If you're going to take someone, take me!
If you're going to take someone, take me!

text_block_list.name: Extremely Tall Woman
text_block_list.text: Popopo...

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
"...Aha☆
Sorry, everyone. That's all for today."

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
"I couldn't join the Night Parade of One Hundred Demons,
but experiencing it for the first time showed me
so many marvelous things☆"

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Then it was totally worth looking more like you guys, even if it's just on the outside☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry, I'll spread the word☆
All about the marvelous ones
stirring in the dark of night★☆

As soon as she said that, the monstrous beings
vanished silently into nowhere—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
...Thanks for coming, Trainer☆
Well then, shall we head home for today?

Afterward, without any major trouble,
I was able to return to the academy with Marvelous Sunday—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
We're heeere! Thanks, Trainer☆
Thanks to you, it's been an absolutely marvelous night★

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Not at all☆ In that moment, Trainer, you were
the most marvelous of all! That's why I'm super happy★
choice_data_list: Still, if I think it's dangerous, I'll stop you. Always.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
“—So that's what's Marvelous to you, Trainer!
Got it! Let's go meet something Marvelous
together again next night☆★☆”

That bewitching invitation strangely set my heart racing.
Ah, I thought to myself—this, too, is Marvelous.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: —Well, well, well~?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Ahahahaha☆
We're going around and around in circles in the same spot★

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Roger that☆
This marvelous night is far from over★

Afterward, despite losing her way multiple times,
she enjoyed the long night and headed back to the
academy feeling truly marvelous.
